title: By hook or by crook: Meaning and Examples — Word Power 71
content:
## By hook or by crook

**Word Power 71 · English idioms**

### Meaning

By any method possible, even a dishonest one.

### Usage

1. I want to get this licence by hook or by crook.
2. Today's politician is interested in nothing but gaining power, be it by hook or by crook.

### Your turn

Use “by hook or by crook” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
